definition: A change in benefit value, employee contributions, or employer benefit costs.
analytical_unit: deduplicated municipality × compensation cycle × compensation mechanism × side implementation event
caption: This map shows 65 distinct documented benefit cost change implementation events across 53 municipalities in 15 states. A change in benefit value, employee contributions, or employer benefit costs. The geography matters because it locates the process in the retained evidence. Darker areas contain more events, not more workers or larger wage effects, and the map is not a national prevalence estimate.
